cohort: Pregnant women at 37-42 weeks of gestation who had antepartum sonographic measurement of BPD within 7 days before delivery, excluding those with known fetal abnormalities or prelabor CD
finding: The study found that increased BPD within the week prior to delivery was associated with a progressively higher risk of obstetric intervention (OVD and CD), but no clear cut-off value for intervention was found, and increased BPD did not appear to have an adverse impact on immediate neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Increased fetal biparietal diameter was associated with a higher risk of obstetric intervention, including operative vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery.
